moments.title: Belle Isle State Park
moments.text: West of Somers, a park on a peninsula of tidewater marsh between Deep Creek and Morattico Creek, on land patented in 1652 and known in those years as Powell's Quarter.

moments.title: Christ Church
moments.text: The only colonial Virginia church still keeping its original high-backed pews, and John Carter, who paid for the first church here, lies in the grounds beside four of his five wives.
